scope: Completed 50-task baseline, 50-task RSI candidate and cumulative168-call search. Earlier single-task engineering runs excluded. Copied baseline and failed search evidence counted only once.
existing: per-call input/output/cache tokens and reservation accounting
local ledger UUID, search role, returned model, reservation timestamp, status
raw response body ID, created timestamp, system_fingerprint, finish_reason
per-task worker elapsed seconds and raw tool outputs with return codes
task/base commit, dataset/config/runner/harness hashes, image digests
candidate diff, proposal, critic, smoke, decisions, final selected version
official patch application and per-test FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS results for submitted patches
baseline reuse and diagnostic recovery provenance; failed-attempt costs; cleanup checks

future_instrumentation: API request start/end/latency and HTTP request IDs/status codes in structured events
sanitized exact API request payload including actual tools, tool choice, extra_body and omitted-parameter list
explicit supported sampling parameters or explicit unsupported/default status
separate image pull, worker, grading and end-to-end wall times; peak resource metrics if needed
derived_from_existing_artifacts: tool call counts and durations where timestamps support them; output truncation events and context-size estimates clearly labeled estimated
failure taxonomy and paired task transitions
research_protocol: feedback/selection/heldout split manifest with hashes and usage role
independent search replicate IDs and repeated task execution design
operational D/P/I/V stage definitions and intervention provenance, distinct from native RRSI role names
billing: timestamped price schedule and estimated cost by input-cache-hit/input-cache-miss/output
currency and estimate-versus-provider-billed distinction; actual invoice reconciliation when available

limitations: Current temperature/top_p use provider defaults and no seed was supplied; historical actual defaults cannot be recovered from local records.
Response model and fingerprint do not establish an immutable weight snapshot.
Raw API response is stored, not a standalone exact serialized request for every call.
Per-task worker seconds are not per-call latency or total experiment wall time.
Internal zero cost placeholders and charged_tokens are not currency billing.
No per-step container filesystem snapshots or hidden reasoning traces.
